title: Perimeter
summary: Start: enter the system. The log opens Perimeter and the helm marks Last Stake. Do: Close on Last Stake. The law is red. A raider takes a keel that lingers, and an ambush holds the stake until you enter 520 meters. The pocket is still a garden. Finish: come inside Last Stake's shell. The Charter writes standing. Wreck rights stay red. Fail: there is no timer. Leave and the job stays open until you close.
